digest.lead: Banks are scrambling to address cybersecurity concerns after U.S. regulators summoned executives to discuss risks from Anthropic's latest Claude model, while skeptics question whether the security claims are oversold.
digest.summary: Meanwhile, Claude Code received a substantial update with team collaboration features, and Anthropic launched dedicated financial services offerings to address enterprise needs.

stories.headline: U.S. Regulators Summon Bank Executives Over Claude Cybersecurity Risks
stories.summary: U.S. financial regulators have called emergency meetings with bank executives to discuss cybersecurity risks posed by Anthropic's latest Claude model [1]. Critics argue that claims about the model's security capabilities may be overstated, with one analysis suggesting that assertions of "thousands of severe zero-days" are based on limited manual reviews [2].
key_points: Federal regulators expressing serious concerns about AI model security implications for banking infrastructure
Debate over whether Anthropic's security claims are substantiated or primarily marketing-driven
stories.perspectives: While regulators are taking a cautious approach to potential cyber risks, security researchers question whether the threat assessment is based on solid evidence or inflated claims.
stories.impact: Banks using or considering Claude for sensitive operations now face regulatory scrutiny and may need to reassess their AI security protocols.

sources.title: US summons bank bosses over cyber risks from Anthropic's latest AI model
Anthropic's Claude Mythos isn't a sentient super-hacker, it's a sales pitch

stories.headline: Anthropic Launches Dedicated Claude for Financial Services
stories.summary: Anthropic announced Claude for Financial Services, a specialized offering targeting the banking and finance sector [1]. The launch comes amid heightened regulatory attention to AI security risks in financial institutions.
stories.impact: Financial firms now have access to a Claude variant specifically designed for their compliance and security requirements, potentially addressing some regulatory concerns.

stories.headline: Claude Code v2.1.101 Adds Team Onboarding and Enterprise TLS Support
stories.summary: The latest Claude Code update introduces a `/team-onboarding` command that generates teammate ramp-up guides from local usage patterns [1]. The release also adds default OS certificate store trust for seamless enterprise TLS proxy integration and auto-creates cloud environments for remote session features [1].
key_points: New team onboarding feature helps organizations scale Claude Code adoption
Enterprise TLS proxy support removes setup friction for corporate environments
Remote session features now work out-of-the-box without web configuration
stories.impact: Teams adopting Claude Code will find it easier to onboard new developers and integrate with existing enterprise infrastructure, reducing deployment barriers.

stories.headline: Show HN: Eve – Managed OpenClaw for Work Environments
stories.summary: A new project called Eve has launched, offering managed OpenClaw services for workplace deployment [1]. The project gained attention on Hacker News with community discussion around enterprise AI tooling solutions.
stories.impact: Organizations looking for managed AI solutions now have another option that builds on the OpenClaw ecosystem, potentially expanding Claude's reach in enterprise environments.

sources.title: Show HN: Eve – Managed OpenClaw for work

stories.headline: Use `/team-onboarding` command to generate teammate ramp-up guides
stories.summary: Claude Code can automatically create onboarding documentation for new team members based on your local usage patterns. This saves time creating training materials and ensures consistency in how team members learn your workflows.
actionable_steps: Update to Claude Code v2.1.101 or later
Run the `/team-onboarding` command in your Claude Code interface
Review the generated ramp-up guide and customize as needed
Share the guide with new team members

stories.headline: Configure streaming timeout for better connection handling
stories.summary: The new CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS environment variable lets you customize how long Claude Code waits before timing out idle streaming connections. This helps prevent unnecessary disconnections during long-running operations.
actionable_steps: Choose a timeout value in milliseconds (default is 90000 for 90 seconds)
Restart Claude Code for the setting to take effect

stories.headline: Set CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1 to eliminate screen flickering
stories.summary: This environment variable enables flicker-free alt-screen rendering with virtualized scrollback in Claude Code v2.1.88+. It provides a smoother visual experience when Claude Code switches between screen modes during long coding sessions.
actionable_steps: Add 'export CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1' to your shell profile (.bashrc, .zshrc, etc.)
Restart your terminal or run 'source ~/.bashrc' to apply the change
Launch Claude Code to verify flicker-free rendering is active

stories.headline: Use @-mentions to give Claude Code precise file context
stories.summary: Boris Cherny, creator of Claude Code, recommends using @-mentions to point Claude at specific files instead of letting it search. This dramatically reduces token usage and improves accuracy since Claude works with the exact files you intend rather than guessing from project structure.
actionable_steps: Type @ in Claude Code to see a file picker with fuzzy search
Select the specific files relevant to your task before writing your prompt
Combine multiple @-mentions for cross-file tasks like refactoring

stories.headline: Use /powerup command to learn Claude Code features interactively
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.90 introduced the /powerup command that provides interactive lessons with animated demos to help you learn Claude Code features. This is particularly useful for new users who want to quickly understand the tool's capabilities through hands-on tutorials.
actionable_steps: Update Claude Code to version 2.1.90 or later
Type `/powerup` in the Claude Code interface
Follow the interactive lessons and animated demos to learn features
